title: The Moon is More Useful

full_text:
Two philosophers were debating in the tea-house whether the sun or the moon was the greater celestial blessing to humanity. The debate grew heated, with each citing ancient astronomical charts.

Seeing Mulla Nasruddin sipping his mint tea in the corner, they turned to him: "Tell us, Mulla! As a man of practical wisdom, which is more useful to mankind: the sun or the moon?"

Nasruddin pondered for a moment, stroked his beard, and answered decisively: "The moon is infinitely more useful than the sun!"

The philosophers were surprised: "How do you figure that, Mulla?"

"The reason is obvious to any thinking person!" explained Nasruddin. "The sun shines only during the daytime, when it is already bright and nobody needs light! But the moon shines in the middle of the pitch-black night, when it is dark and we truly need illumination! Therefore, the moon is far superior!"
moral: People often undervalue constant blessings while praising what arrives in moments of darkness.
